changelog: An invalid input lies on the pastel `dangerSoft`, without shadow nor red ring (`FlInputFrame.invalid`): every invalid input of the registry says it the same way, the error in words under it. `touchFocusRing: false`: the focus ring shows only when focus moves by keyboard; under touch, the caret alone says where the text goes, as in iOS's fields. `invalid` makes the field invalid without a text under it, the reason said elsewhere (a toast).

breaking.description: An invalid input no longer draws a `danger` ring: `FlInputFrame.invalid` lays it on `dangerSoft`. A frame you build with `outline: colors.danger` for an error should pass `invalid: true` instead.
